```artifact
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from your_module import your_function

class TestVirtua3_4(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_tc_001(self):
        # Test case for requirement VIRTUA-3.4-1
        # The system will be available on hospital Padmavathi website as a URL and will be operational using standard web-browsers (Safari, Google Chrome and firefox).
        url = "https://hospital-padmavathi.com"
        response = requests.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_tc_002(self):
        # Test case for requirement VIRTUA-3.4-2
        # Patients, Chemists and Labs will connect through a secured encrypted connection over internet (https://).
        url = "https://example.com"
        with patch('requests.get') as mock_get:
            mock_get.return_value.status_code = 200
            response = requests.get(url)
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_tc_003(self):
        # Test case for requirement VIRTUA-3.4-3
        # Encrypted protocols are used to prevent data leakages.
        # This test case is for negative path, where data leakage is attempted.
        url = "http://example.com"
        with patch('requests.get') as mock_get:
            mock_get.return_value.status_code = 200
            response = requests.get(url)
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

    def test_tc_004(self):
        # Test case for requirement VIRTUA-3.4-4
        # E-mails shall be used to send the Prescription and Invoice to the Patients after Consultation.
        # This test case is for positive path, where email is sent successfully.
        email = "patient@example.com"
        with patch('smtplib.SMTP') as mock_smtp:
            mock_smtp.return_value.sendmail.return_value = None
            your_function(email)
            self.assertTrue(True)

    def test_tc_005(self):
        # Test case for requirement VIRTUA-3.4-4
        # E-mails shall be used to send the Prescription and Invoice to the Patients after Consultation.
        # This test case is for negative path, where email sending fails.
        email = "invalid_email"
        with patch('smtplib.SMTP') as mock_smtp:
            mock_smtp.return_value.sendmail.return_value = None
            your_function(email)
            self.assertTrue(False)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
